core_delta: OLD_EPOCH != STALE: causal validity and current-state applicability are separate dimensions.
A late verified outcome must first close its exact origin episode/action/receiver retrospectively; only then can a separately validated consequence be transported into the current semantic epoch.
Separate retrospective causal closure from forward current-state application.
Arrival epoch must never overwrite origin epoch; causal identity survives asynchronous delay and out-of-order delivery.
Durable learning admission must be exactly-once across duplicate receipts and restart.
Semantically expired evidence may still close history/memory while being blocked from fast current control.
The synthetic test strongly supports origin binding but does not establish that complex rebasing beats a simpler verified origin-bound update law.

synthetic_out_of_box_experiment.novelty: Treat Frank feedback as an asynchronous networked-control / delayed-measurement problem with recurring semantic contexts.
supported: causal origin binding is high-value under delayed out-of-order outcomes
strict current-epoch equality is invalid for legitimate asynchronous outcomes
provenance validation helps as corruption rises
not_supported: raw origin innovation universally beats simple verified origin-bound outcome feedback
complex rebasing universally beats simple verified origin-bound outcome feedback

clayresearch.delta: Add causal-origin-time versus application-time as a first-class axis in the perfect-loop synthesis and preserve the simpler origin-bound counterhypothesis.
clayresearch.required_next_test: A/B causal-origin binding, strict epoch rejection and rebased forward application under matched delay/out-of-order/restart episodes.

frank.delta: Refine the perfected Frank loop so ResponseAnalyzer/outcome feedback closes exact origin episodes before any current-state influence; old valid outcomes are not discarded merely by epoch age.
frank.required_next_test: Historical tool/response episodes with delayed outcome reconstruction, exact origin mapping and current relevance classification.

gwt.delta: Late outcome closure alone does not imply workspace re-ignition. Reopen GWT only when the forward-admitted consequence materially changes current residual/uncertainty/goal state.
gwt.required_next_test: Delayed outcome: retrospective closure only vs closure+reignite vs blind current injection, measuring false/missed ignition and receiver closure.

emergenz.delta: Do not score asynchronous recurrence/activity as emergence; use shuffled arrival-time and origin-identity controls to separate causal delayed closure from temporal correlation.
emergenz.required_next_test: Origin-preserved/time-shuffled/origin-shuffled/no-reentry factorial with outcome and cross-timescale causal readouts.

claycode.delta: Current G9 Delta/IncrementalReceipt/reentry semantics need an executable counterexample test for origin_epoch, arrival_epoch, apply_epoch, retrospective closure, forward transport and exactly-once admission. Change semantics only if current constructs cannot express it cleanly.
claycode.required_next_test: Compile a minimal delayed-outcome program through current parser/type/effect/evaluator/runtime; require duplicate/out-of-order/restart equivalence.

hyperposition.delta: Late valid evidence can reopen a previously preserved alternative only when it changes the current evidence relation; age alone neither collapses nor reopens a branch.
hyperposition.required_next_test: Delayed evidence arriving after branch choice: archive-only vs rebase/reopen vs blind reopen.

claygraph.delta: Project origin_episode -> delayed_outcome -> verification -> retrospective_credit -> forward_rebase/apply edges with distinct epochs and immutable lineage.
claygraph.required_next_test: Reconstruct paths after out-of-order delivery/restart and prove arrival-time topology cannot masquerade as causal-origin topology.

unifieddb.delta: Persist pending effects, origin episode identity, outcome arrival/verification time, retrospective admission, current-epoch rebase receipt and durable-learning idempotency separately.
unifieddb.required_next_test: Exactly-once replay with duplicates, out-of-order results, restart between action/outcome and semantically expired but historically valid outcomes.

harness.delta: Extend H1 perfect-loop differential with asynchronous outcome delay/out-of-order/duplicate/restart conditions; compare strict epoch, receipt-current, origin-verified and origin+rebase candidates.
harness.required_next_test: Frozen real episodes plus injected delay/out-of-order/duplicate/restart; measure missed/false credit, state contamination, task outcome, recurrence/GWT, replay equivalence, latency and resources.

global_controls: retrospective truth update != current action authority
synthetic mechanism evidence != Frank runtime proof
simpler verified origin-bound feedback remains a live counterhypothesis
